# ITechLK Store

> Sri Lanka's trusted online marketplace for premium digital subscriptions. We offer carefully curated digital products including AI tools, streaming services, VPN subscriptions, creative software, productivity tools, and more—all delivered fast at the best prices in Sri Lanka.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://itechlk.com): Main storefront and featured promotions.
- [Shop](https://itechlk.com/shop): Browse and search all digital subscription products.
- [Contact Us](https://itechlk.com/contact): Customer support channels including WhatsApp, email, and live chat.
- [Blog](https://itechlk.com/blog): Latest articles, product guides, and store updates.

## Product Categories

- [AI Tools](https://itechlk.com/shop?category=AI%20Tools): Subscriptions for ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Midjourney, Gemini Advanced, and more.
- [Streaming](https://itechlk.com/shop?category=Streaming): Subscriptions for Netflix, Disney+, Spotify, YouTube Premium, etc.
- [VPNs](https://itechlk.com/shop?category=VPNs): Subscriptions for NordVPN, ExpressVPN, Surfshark, and other private networks.
- [Creative & Editing](https://itechlk.com/shop?category=Creative%20%26%20Editing): Subscriptions for Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva Pro, CapCut Pro, etc.
- [Work & OS](https://itechlk.com/shop?category=Work%20%26%20OS): Microsoft 365, Windows licenses, and general productivity software.

## Key Services

- **Fast Delivery**: Instant or rapid delivery of genuine accounts and product keys.
- **Local Payment Options**: Pay in LKR (Sri Lankan Rupees) using local credit/debit cards and payment methods.
- **Customer Support**: Available in both English and Sinhala via WhatsApp and live chat.
